dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I must admit that though I'm glad we're all finally safe, I do feel just a bit unsatisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: The Angel's Share was seriously affected by the dragon attacks as many of its popular drinks had their supplies cut.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Here at the Cat's Tail, we even had an ongoing discount to take further advantage...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: ...But in the end, our sales were still a little less than theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Still, there's not much I can do about that. It is supplied directly by the Dawn Winery, after all, which gives it an overwhelming advantage in terms of where they get their wine...
